settings.heading: What are the benefits of Merino wool socks?
settings.row_content: Merino wool socks offer natural temperature regulation, breathability, and moisture-wicking properties. They keep your feet dry, warm in winter, and cool in summer—making them ideal for hiking, work, or everyday wear.

settings.heading: Are your Merino wool socks made in Australia?
settings.row_content: Yes, all our Merino wool socks are proudly Australian made using 100% locally sourced Merino wool. We support Australian farmers and manufacturers to ensure high-quality, ethical production.

settings.heading: Are Merino wool socks good for hiking?
settings.row_content: Absolutely. Merino hiking socks are a top choice for hikers due to their ability to reduce blisters, manage moisture, and stay comfortable on long treks. They're also naturally odor-resistant.

settings.heading: Can I wear Merino wool socks for work?
settings.row_content: Yes. Merino wool work socks provide all-day comfort, especially for tradies, farmers, and anyone on their feet. They're durable, cushioned, and breathable—perfect for tough conditions.

settings.heading: Are Merino wool socks itchy?
settings.row_content: Unlike traditional wool, Merino wool is ultra-fine and soft against the skin. Our socks are designed to be itch-free and comfortable for all-day wear.

settings.heading: How do I care for Merino wool socks?
settings.row_content: To keep your Merino socks in top condition, wash them in cold water on a gentle cycle and air dry. Avoid hot water or tumble drying to preserve the natural fibres.
